body.prose:
A version stores a holon's identity, what it is an instance of, and its body. Instance is the one relation the store knows itself, because it is what gives a body its meaning: a type says what its instances hold, and the engine checks a body against it at commit. A holon may be an instance of several types.

*The author's, 2026-11-02: something is an instance of something, that makes perfect sense; the store holds everything.*

Two more are to stand beside them, out of the body, since the engine reads them whatever a holon's type: its name, as [beneath](ref:01M6M9PESEPYSZBYWQVD709ACJ), and, for a type, its mould, what its instances hold. The body is then only what a holon holds itself. Neither is built.

*The author's, 2026-11-05: I thought name was something first class for holons; fields goes out of the body; mould, for now, for the word, a cast for what comes from it and never for itself.*
body.title: What is stored
